rites.name: Ilovaramira
rites.text: Ilovaramira is a concept of Crurnon, a sounding born in the Singing when the first roots of the world condensed into the groves of the first sovereign. It is remembered as the quiet force that shaped growing kingdoms and taught the young groves how to hold their ground.

rites.name: Broradeld
rites.text: Broradeld is a concept of Crurnon's Seeding, the quiet stretch when makers plant the Weave and dormant powers sleep. It names the disciplined sense that guides a grove's first sovereign as the kingdoms grow up around the groves.

rites.name: Ryinys
rites.text: Ryinys is the concept of the Pact-Thread, a binding that the first sovereign of Crurnon swore to hold kingdoms and groves together through the Sundering. It is said to have held a fracturing grove-wall in place for a season before the Shards settled.

rites.name: Grimaizhoth
rites.text: Grimaizhoth is a concept of the Martial Realm, a binding oath-flame that the orders of the Holy Age kindled during the Sundering to hold broken worlds to the Pact. Its wardens are said to carry its ember into temple fires and shatter-fields alike.

rites.name: Calles
rites.text: A drummer performs an improvised percussion showcase during live gigs, often woven into longer pieces. The showcase keeps shifting over the years, yet the performer still plays it today.

rites.name: Tarium Telus
rites.text: A chant-like hymn about the power to choose one's path, presented as a decision one must actively make rather than a blessing bestowed. Its closing passage is sung at the highest reach of a singer's range.

rites.name: Haloldath
rites.text: Haloldath is the disciplined craft by which Crurnon's Martial practitioners bind raw sparks of heat and motion into lasting engines and ritual seals. Its adepts train for years in tempering, measuring and sealing, until a single well-made bronze forge can hold a town's worth of pressure. The art is prized less for its violence than for its patience.

rites.name: Brorne
rites.text: Brorne is a discipline of forbidden alchemy in the Crurnon Martial age, letting a practitioner override the ordinary laws of matter to force impossible transformations. Its signature act binds living essence into crystalline hardness, an achievement that sparked a bitter doctrinal war with the guild of timekeepers.

rites.name: Haluldenon
rites.text: Haluldenon is a sky-cast signal technique in the Martial realm of Crurnon, where a false beacon is woven from gathered storm-light and bent across the dark to draw drifting vessels toward jagged reefs. The practitioners of this craft are scavengers who strip what the sea leaves behind, and their illusion is said to hold for a full night.
